_comment: Approved grade-equivalence decisions that the cross-reference master does not (yet) carry.
build.py applies these on top of the master: a master cell equal to "master" is replaced by "approved"; one already equal to "approved" is left; anything else stops the build for a decision.
Without this file a rebuild from GAIL_PE_CrossReference_Master.xlsx reverts every entry below (verified 2026-09-29).
